title: Grateful Dead Live at Kresge Plaza, M.I.T. on 1970-05-06
lineage: 2022 reseed: SBE repaired in track 04, SHN files re-encoded to FLAC-8: SHN>WAV>FLAC-8
source: MSR (MIT Reels) > Sonic Solutions Digital Editing (gans) > DATs > CDRs > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures the raw 1970 energy with Jerry’s thunderous guitar work
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a lively, post‑Fillmore vibe that lets listeners hear Jerry Garcia both thundering and softly phrasing, evoking the classic ’70 sound. Though it’s an audience copy, the ambience is clear enough to enjoy the band cutting loose, making it a compelling listen for true Dead heads.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review but it rates the show highly (4 stars) and praises both performance and overall sound, leading to a solid rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape captures the lively atmosphere and Jerry’s guitar clearly; typical crowd noise is present but does not detract from overall enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic, loose performance reflecting the band’s post‑Fillmore momentum and cutting‑loose style.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for thundering yet soft playing, showcasing strong guitar presence.
